params.name: response_type
params.description: The response type, must be 'code' for authorization code flow

params.name: client_id
params.description: The client identifier issued to the client during registration

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: The URI to redirect to after authorization is complete

params.name: state
params.description: Optional value used by the client to maintain state between request and callback

params.name: code_challenge
params.description: PKCE code challenge derived from the code verifier

params.name: code_challenge_method
params.description: Method used to derive the code challenge, either 'S256' or 'plain'

params.name: flow_type
params.description: If you want to use Nomos as identity provider, you can support a login or signup flow via explicitly setting this parameter. In contrast to the default, the login options skips the consent screen. The signup options allows your users to create a new customer without a subscription attached to it, and therefore register an account.

items.docs: This endpoint can be used to create a customer portal magic link. The link (returned in the `link` property) allows your customer to directly access the customer portal. This is useful if you want to integrate the customer portal into your own application. Remember that it is your responsibility to make sure to provide the correct `customerId` for your user you'd like to log in.
